action: The mud and water wave surges from left to right, rocks tumble at its front, it crashes and spreads out, then settles and seeps away. Keep the same palette and style, transparent background.
seedPrompt: MUDSLIDE: a wide cone-shaped wave of brown mud, ochre stones and indigo water surging from the left side toward the right, splashes and tumbling rocks at the front of the wave, seen from an elevated three-quarter view. Palette: ink black, washi off-white, vermilion, antique gold, plus ochre and umber, indigo and pale aqua. Ragnarok-inspired 2D MMORPG pixel art, hand-crafted look, consistent native pixel density, dark 1-pixel outlines, upper-left light, flat cel shading, no bloom, no soft gradients, no blur, few large readable shapes. Japanese Heian onmyodo and shrine maiden folk magic style: washi paper talismans with fictional brush strokes, folded paper, black and vermilion lacquer, eerie dignified yokai. NOT Thai, NOT Chinese, NOT Indonesian, NOT Slavic, NOT anime: no neon, no lens flare, no sparkle stars, no glowing crystals, no lightning, no torii gate, no pentagram or star shape, no taiji, no swastika or manji, no rising sun rays, no runes, no readable kanji or text, no religious symbols, no character, no person, no blood, no gore, transparent background, empty transparent margins on every side. Whites are warm washi off-white, never pure white.
